title: Parking orbit velocity
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) is correctly expressed as v = r√(g/R).

title: Working orbit period
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is correctly expressed as T = (2πR₁/r₁)√(6R₁/g).

title: Apply Newton's Law for parking orbit
description: Important: Student correctly equates gravitational force to centripetal force (GMm/R² = mv²/R) for the Earth-centered parking orbit.

title: Express Earth's GM
description: Important: Student uses the Earth's surface gravity (g) to correctly substitute GM = gr².

title: Apply Newton's Law for working orbit
description: Important: Student correctly equates the Moon's gravitational force to the centripetal force (GM₁m/R₁² = mω²R₁) for the Moon-centered working orbit.

title: Express Moon's GM₁
description: Important: Student uses the Moon's surface gravity (g/6) to correctly substitute GM₁ = (g/6)r₁².

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Student shows clear, logical steps in solving the simultaneous equations to derive the final expressions.

title: Confusing orbit radii
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses Earth's radius (r) or Moon's radius (r₁) in place of the orbit radii (R, R₁) in the force equations.

title: Incorrect gravity substitution
description: Pitfall: Student uses Earth's 'g' instead of the Moon's 'g/6' when formulating the equation for the Moon-centered working orbit, or vice versa.
